task_description: Write a method in Dafny to count true booleans in the given boolean array.
specification_response:

code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method CountTrues(a: array<bool>) returns (count: int)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The input array should not be null
    
Dafny specification:
    requires a != null
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The returned count equals the number of true elements in the input array

Dafny specification:
    ensures count == |{ i | 0 <= i < a.Length && a[i] }|
  
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method CountTrues(a: array<bool>) returns (count: int)
    requires a != null
    ensures count == |{ i | 0 <= i < a.Length && a[i] }|
{
    count := 0;
    var i := 0;
    while i < a.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= a.Length
        invariant count == |{ k | 0 <= k < i && a[k] }|
    {
        if a[i] {
            count := count + 1;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
